operations.description: Assigns one or more payment terminals to a merchant account or a store. You can also use this endpoint to reassign terminals between merchant accounts or stores, and to unassign a terminal and return it to company inventory.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] assign terminals [PATH] assign terminals [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] assign request response terminals

operations.description: Returns the company account, merchant account, or store that a payment terminal is assigned to.
operations.summary: Get the account or store of a terminal
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] find terminal [PATH] find terminal [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] find request response terminal

operations.description: Returns a list of stores associated with a company account or a merchant account, including the status of each store.
operations.summary: Get the stores of an account
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] stores under account [PATH] stores under account [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] account address request response store stores under

operations.description: Returns the details of a payment terminal, including where the terminal is assigned to. The response returns the same details that are provided in the terminal list in your Customer Area and in the Terminal Fleet report.
operations.summary: Get the details of a terminal
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] terminal details [PATH] terminal details [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] address details request response store terminal

operations.description: Returns a list of payment terminals associated with a company account, merchant account, or store. The response shows whether the terminals are in the inventory, or in-store (ready for boarding or already boarded).
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] terminals under account [PATH] terminals under account [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] account merchant request response store terminals under
